_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Both talk to the RUNNING dev server, so start it
first with `iex-server` (devenv script) -- they will show as disconnected until
the endpoint is listening on :4000.
tidewave: Dashbit's runtime-intelligence server (Apache-2.0, free).
PIN WARNING: we are pinned to 0.8.2 in mix.lock -- tidewave 0.9.0 (Aug 2026)
REMOVED the get_*_schema family incl. get_ash_resources. Upgrading is a
deliberate decision (project_eval + execute_sql_query remain either way),
not a routine deps.update. See docs/research/beam-observer-tooling.md.
ash_ai_dev: the dev-time MCP server that ash_ai itself mounts. Kept because this
repo is a reference for ash_ai and should demonstrate it, but note that
upstream describes it as experimental. The DevTools extension seam here is
the planned surface for the AshAgentTools bridge (Lane E: describe/validate/
context/search as custom MCP tools).
ash_agent (DX-2): the ash_agent_tools dev-only path dep now IS an MCP
server -- the read-only introspection surface (describe/validate/
search/context/forbidden/status/reload) over MCP-over-Plug. Boot it
separately with `mix ash_agent.serve` from the repo root (compile-only;
it must NOT share the iex-server VM), loopback :4100, no auth. Shows as
disconnected until a daemon is listening. Pre-launch gate:
eval/trigger_eval/ in the package (75% per tool; green 2026-09-21).
Serena (optional, not configured here): if installed, point its Elixir backend
at our Expert fork via ls_specific_settings.elixir.ls_path -- see
docs/research/serena-semantic-edits.md. Two-server shape lands with CAP-3.
The PRODUCTION MCP server is a different thing entirely -- it exposes this
application's Ash actions as tools to external agents over OAuth 2.1, and is
mounted in the router, not here.
